    BROCHURE

    Brochure and Spec Sheets

    Find out more

    REMARKS

    1. Finance as necessary and within your ability to repay
    2. Effective Rate 5.10% - 10% per year.
    3. The offers are available for customers who place an order, receive the specified BMW model from 1-30 September 2026.
    4. Vehicle prices include 7% VAT | The company reserves the right to change prices and certain equipment without prior notice.
    5. Vehicle prices include the BSI STANDARD PACKAGE (3 years of maintenance or 60,000 km, whichever comes first) and a 3-year unlimited mileage warranty.
    6. For BMW i Series, prices include the BSI STANDARD PACKAGE (4 years of maintenance or 80,000 km, whichever comes first) and a 4-year unlimited mileage warranty.
    7. Installment rates are calculated based on the retail price including BSI STANDARD PACKAGE, specifically for Hire Purchase with Balloon programs at a 35% down payment, 60-month term, and a final balloon payment of 30-40% of the vehicle price.
      7.1. BMW Freedom Choice installments are calculated based on the retail price including BSI STANDARD PACKAGE at a 35% down payment, 48-month term, and a Guaranteed Future Value (GFV) of 40-60% of the vehicle price.
      7.2. Hire Purchase with Balloon installments are calculated based on the retail price including BSI STANDARD PACKAGE at a 35% down payment, 60-month term, and a final balloon payment of 30-40% of the vehicle price.
    8. Details regarding Hire Purchase with Balloon and BMW Freedom Choice programs—including down payments, installments, interest rates, and services—are subject to the terms and conditions of BMW Financial Services.
    9. Special installment offer of 16,999 THB/month for iX1 eDrive20L M Sport is exclusive to the BMW Freedom Choice program with a 35% down payment, 48-month term, and a 50% Guaranteed Future Value (GFV).
    10. Special installment offers for 220 Gran Coupe M Sport Pro, X1 sDrive20i M Sport, 330e M Sport, iX1 eDrive20L M Sport, 520d M Sport, 520d M Sport Pro, and 530e M Sport, 530e M Sport Pro, 530e Inspiring are exclusive to the Hire Purchase with Balloon program with a 60-month term.
      10.1. 14,555 THB/month for 220 Gran Coupe M Sport Pro with a 35% down payment and a 35% balloon amount.
      10.2. 12,999 THB/month for X1 sDrive20i M Sport with a 34.04% down payment and a 40% balloon amount.
      10.3. 15,999 THB/month for 330e M Sport with a 34.51% down payment and a 40% balloon amount.
      10.4. 17,999 THB/month for iX1 eDrive20L M Sport with a 33.43% down payment and a 30% balloon amount.
      10.5. 22,999 THB/month for 520d M Sport, 520d M Sport Pro, 530e M Sport, 530e M Sport Pro, 530e Inspiring with a 35% down payment for 520d M Sport, 520d M Sport Pro, 530e M Sport, a 30.30% down payment for 530e Inspiring, a 37.04% down payment for 530e M Sport Pro, and a 35% balloon amount.
    11. Customers are entitled to purchase extended warranty packages with unlimited mileage and maintenance services for up to 5 years or 100,000 km (whichever comes first), along with up to 5 years of BMW Mobility Service membership (For BMW i Series, customers may purchase extended warranty and maintenance packages for up to 6 years).
    12. All offers are subject to terms and conditions specified by the Company. BMW Financial Services reserves the right to amend financing terms and conditions without prior notice. BMW Thailand reserves the right to amend any information, specifications, model details, or product descriptions at any time without prior notice and shall not be held responsible for any typographical or printing errors.
